hypothesis: The four feedback signals the pipeline never cached (is_follow, is_comment, is_hate, is_profile_enter) contain information transferable to long_view that the existing click/like/forward auxiliary heads do not capture.
mechanism: Four additional binary auxiliary heads over the SHARED FM embeddings. Gradient from each head flows into the shared user/video/author/tab/duration embeddings; long_view remains the sole primary (BPR) objective. The auxiliary labels are never inputs.

design.treatment: identical config, multitask=aux_social4 -- the ONLY difference
design.pairing: paired by seed; both arms trained fresh on the rebuilt cache
design.aux_weight_note: the existing default. NOT tuned, NOT swept. This probe asks whether there is signal at all.

promotion_criteria_fixed_before_running.PROMOTE: mean paired delta(primary) >= +0.0008 (1 sigma) AND paired t > 2.0
promotion_criteria_fixed_before_running.headline_rule: report the MEAN paired delta, never the best individual seed
promotion_criteria_fixed_before_running.no_ensemble_selection: no ensemble will be rebuilt or chosen on the basis of this result

prior: multitask class measures INCONCLUSIVE at 0.21 sigma over 55 experiments. Expected value low, remaining uncertainty real, cost non-zero -- which is why exactly one probe is justified.

leakage_audit.when_observed: all four are outcomes of the impression being scored, identical in status to is_click/is_like/is_forward already in use
leakage_audit.test_split: added to data_boundary.TEST_LABEL_COLUMNS, so the sandbox test split carries none of them
leakage_audit.verification: agent.leakage_check run against the generated script before execution
